Fail-closed: only when authenticated===true (legacy/missing→false). Privacy: seal signed w/ B key (A authenticates decliner), outer ephemeral (B hidden), zero profile metadata. findings.note: CARRY-FORWARD TO S6 (not S5 defect): double-invocation declinePendingInvitation → two decline wraps to A; S6 must dedupe two genuine sends from one B, not only relay redelivery.

findings.note: SECURITY (AC-IMMUT-6/DD-11 announcement-immutability bypass at TTL-expiry×late-target ordering). A pre-emptive ordinary edit targeting an unknown id fabricated a placeholder ChatMessage via appendMessage; insert-if-absent then made a later REAL announcement at that id silently no-op, permanently replacing it with attacker content. NOT enumerated by the S8 per-apply-site review (missed the cross-arrival interaction between a gated signal's fabricated-row side effect and the storage dedup primitive). Caught by S9's crossCuttingImmutabilityInvariance enumeration (VQ-S9-010). FIXED: ChatMessage.materializedFromEdit flag marks TTL-materialized placeholders; appendMessage overwrites ONLY a flagged placeholder in-place when a fresh unflagged genuine message arrives at the same id; real rows never clobbered. Verified adversarially: single-source flag setter (api.ts), no real path sets it, placeholders can never be announcements (AC-IMMUT-7 rejection precedes fabrication), overwrite content hash-id-bound, dedup floor preserved, delete path uses content-free markers (no masquerade), no flag leakage. Both admin and non-admin covered. New regression: chatPersistence-editDelete.test.ts.

resolved_carryforwards: S7->S8 admin carve-out send+receive CLOSED (AC-IMMUT-3 functional)
S9-surfaced TTL-expiry×late-target immutability bypass CLOSED (materializedFromEdit supersession)
